english.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for the act or words of boasting.
This is the all-purpose noun for a boast or boastful talk, especially an exaggerated claim.

examples.english: All his talk about knowing everything is just a boast.
examples.traditional: 佢成日話自己乜都識，真係吹牛。
